title: Open inguinal hernia repair
count_points: Reconciliation count of needles, swabs and instruments
Sign out confirms the count before the patient leaves theatre

sources.title: Back table set-up for an open incisional hernia repair with mesh (JoMI, South College)
sources.took: Instrument names and counts from the back-table instrument count, and 5 laps and 10 Ray-Tecs. It is an open incisional repair, the closest published open hernia tray list found. Where it differs from source 2, the smaller quantity is used. Names and quantities only.

sources.title: Set-up for an open incisional hernia repair (JoMI, Ivy Tech)
sources.took: A second, independent programme's counts: 5 laps, 10 Ray-Tecs, 2 knife handles, 3 needle drivers, 2 Babcock, 1 Yankauer. Used as the cross-check and for the smaller quantity where the two differ. Names and quantities only.

sources.title: StatPearls: Open Inguinal Hernia Repair
sources.took: Confirms the open inguinal tray holds a scalpel, Metzenbaum scissors, mosquito clamps, a needle driver, skin and non-traumatic forceps and a self-retaining retractor. Used only to confirm names. Page licence is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0, so no text is reused.

sources.title: Outcome of open inguinal hernia repair, modified Lichtenstein 2-point fixed technique (Thai surgical journal, 2025)
sources.took: Mean operative time 30.65 minutes (SD 13.38, range 10 to 120, 668 patients). It is the largest series fetched, so 31 minutes is the expected time. Other published open repair means run higher, up to about 80 minutes.

sources.title: AORN: retained surgical items questions answered (2026)
sources.took: Count items at least once before the procedure to set a baseline, and count instruments when a body cavity is open. Counting soft goods and sharps follows organisational policy.

sources.title: NatSSIPs 2 sequential steps flowchart (AfPP, 2023)
sources.took: Step 6 is the reconciliation count of items including needles, swabs and instruments. Step 7 is sign out, after the count.

note: Patients are synthetic. Names and quantities are taken from the sources listed.
